overview: 今日专题“全球治理与外交”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: Israel sanctions will not hurt intelligence sharing between spy agencies, says Miliband
featured.summary: UK foreign secretary says international community including US shares ‘frustration’ at Israel’s failure to constrain illegal settlers British intelligence has been given assurances by its Israeli counterpart that information sharing with the UK will continue as before, Ed Miliband, the foreign secretary, has said. The disclosure counters predictions that his decision to impose a ban on trade with illegal Israeli settlements would lead to a collapse in cooperation between the agencies. Continue reading...
featured.titleZh: 米利班德称，以色列制裁不会损害情报机构间的情报共享
featured.summaryZh: 英国外交大臣米利班德表示，尽管英国对以色列非法定居点实施了贸易禁令，但已获得以色列方面的保证，双方的情报合作将保持不变。此举旨在平息关于合作可能破裂的猜测。
featured.whyImportant: 这表明英国在对以政策上试图在外交制裁与国家安全合作之间寻求平衡。

global.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
global.summary: The fire broke out as the vessel nearing its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan.
global.titleZh: 菲律宾一渡轮发生“令人心碎”的火灾，造成5人死亡，86人失踪
global.summaryZh: 这艘渡轮在接近旅游胜地巴拉望岛科隆时突然起火。目前搜救工作正在进行中。
global.whyImportant: 此次海上事故造成了严重的人员伤亡，引发了对当地渡轮安全标准的关注。

global.title: Netanyahu to sue Haaretz over claims UAE warned him before October 7 attack
global.summary: Israeli prime minister denies claim that UAE president warned him of Hamas plans before the 2023 attacks.
global.titleZh: 内塔尼亚胡将起诉《国土报》，因其报道称阿联酋在10月7日袭击前曾发出警告
global.summaryZh: 以色列总理否认了关于阿联酋总统在2023年袭击发生前曾向其通报哈马斯计划的说法。他计划就此报道采取法律行动。
global.whyImportant: 此举反映了以色列政府对战前情报预警相关报道的高度敏感及政治压力。

global.titleZh: 澳大利亚政治直播：公共部门工会宣布新领导人；民调显示工党在处理家庭暴力问题上行动迟缓
global.summaryZh: 澳大利亚工党正计划引入新法律以打击非法烟草贸易，通过更严格的包装和价格标准赋予边境执法部门更多权力。同时，政府在应对家庭暴力问题上的表现受到民调批评。
global.whyImportant: 政府在打击非法贸易和应对社会民生问题上的政策调整，直接影响其执政支持率。

global.title: SMH columnist Peter FitzSimons tells Alan Jones trial alleged victim was ‘revolted’ by abuse
global.summary: FitzSimons tells court that complainant C told him Jones, who has pleaded not guilty, would touch his penis and he ‘kept pushing it away’ Listen to the podcast Alan Jones on Trial Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Sydney Morning Herald columnist Peter FitzSimons has told the Alan Jones trial an alleged victim he spoke to in 2019 was “tearful” and sounded “emotionally traumatised” when detailing alleged assaults by the 2GB broadcaster. The commentator and author gave evidence in the Downing Centre local court on Thursday about a telephone call he had with the alleged victim known as complainant C in October 2019. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 《悉尼先驱晨报》专栏作家彼得·菲茨西蒙斯在艾伦·琼斯案审判中称受害者感到“反感”
global.summaryZh: 菲茨西蒙斯在法庭上作证称，他在2019年与一名受害者通话时，对方详细描述了广播员艾伦·琼斯对其进行的性骚扰。琼斯目前对指控表示不认罪。
global.whyImportant: 该案件涉及知名媒体人的性侵指控，在澳大利亚社会引起了广泛关注。

global.title: US citizens will receive $5,000 if Republicans win midterms, Trump claims in lengthy convention speech
global.summary: In two-hour address, president asked voters to ‘pretend that I’m on the ballot’ despite being deeply unpopular among electorate Donald Trump said every adult citizen in the US will receive a dividend of $5,000 if Republicans retain the House and Senate in the midterm elections, while delivering a historically long convention speech in Dallas in which the president assailed Democrats as radical communists and defended his unpopular war in Iran. “If the Republicans win, you win with us, and you get $5,000,” Trump told the Republican midterm convention in Dallas on Wednesday, claiming the payment was possible “because of our tremendous strength and success economically”. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 特朗普在竞选集会上声称，若共和党赢得中期选举，美国公民将获得5000美元
global.summaryZh: 特朗普在达拉斯的集会上承诺，如果共和党能保住参众两院的控制权，每位成年公民将获得5000美元的红利。他同时抨击了民主党并为伊朗战争辩护。
global.whyImportant: 这一激进的经济承诺是特朗普试图在中期选举中动员选民的重要策略。

global.title: Israel sanctions will not hurt intelligence sharing between spy agencies, says Miliband
global.summary: UK foreign secretary says international community including US shares ‘frustration’ at Israel’s failure to constrain illegal settlers British intelligence has been given assurances by its Israeli counterpart that information sharing with the UK will continue as before, Ed Miliband, the foreign secretary, has said. The disclosure counters predictions that his decision to impose a ban on trade with illegal Israeli settlements would lead to a collapse in cooperation between the agencies. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 米利班德称，以色列制裁不会损害情报机构间的情报共享
global.summaryZh: 英国外交大臣米利班德表示，尽管英国对以色列非法定居点实施了贸易禁令，但已获得以色列方面的保证，双方的情报合作将保持不变。此举旨在平息关于合作可能破裂的猜测。
global.whyImportant: 这表明英国在对以政策上试图在外交制裁与国家安全合作之间寻求平衡。

global.title: Lawmakers blast AI companies after researcher warns of human extinction by 2030
global.summary: Former Anthropic employee Jacob Coxon said AI will become ‘superhuman systems’ that can cause human extinction by the end of the decade Just a day after three Anthropic researchers warned that artificial intelligence could kill off humanity within the decade, lawmakers have begun lashing out about the risks of the burgeoning technology. Ted Cruz, a republican senator from Texas, said in an interview on ABC’s The View, that AI poses a “catastrophic risk” and that he “read that whole tweet thread that that developer put out. It was highly concerning. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 研究人员警告人工智能可能导致人类灭绝，立法者猛烈抨击AI公司
global.summaryZh: 前Anthropic员工雅各布·考克森警告称，人工智能可能在十年内演变为导致人类灭绝的“超人系统”。对此，美国参议员泰德·克鲁兹等立法者表达了严重关切。
global.whyImportant: 人工智能的潜在生存风险正促使政界加强对科技行业的监管审查。

global.title: US scrambles to match China’s air-breathing hypersonic missiles with Darpa programme
global.summary: A year after China unveiled the world’s first operational air-breathing hypersonic missiles, the United States is launching a programme to double down on developing similar weapons. The US Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency (Darpa) will bring contractors together later this month to lay out what it wants from the Next Generation Hypersonic Cruise Missile, with air-breathing propulsion at the heart of the project, according to the agency’s website. Unlike rocket-powered missiles,...
global.titleZh: 美国加紧研发“吸气式”高超音速导弹以追赶中国
global.summaryZh: 在美国国防高级研究计划局（DARPA）的推动下，美国正启动新一代高超音速巡航导弹项目。此举旨在应对中国在吸气式高超音速武器领域取得的领先地位。
global.whyImportant: 大国之间在高超音速武器技术上的竞争加剧，对全球军事平衡产生深远影响。

global.title: Enact Trew’s law to automatically review ‘bent copper’ convictions, says report
global.summary: Experts say failure to immediately review cases involving corrupt police officers risks ‘ruining’ more lives Convictions that imprisoned police officers were involved in obtaining should be automatically reviewed to correct miscarriages of justice such as those perpetrated by the corrupt and racist officer DS Derek Ridgewell, a report says. The proposed Trew’s law, named after Winston Trew – who was framed by Ridgewell and spent decades fighting to clear his name – would trigger an immediate, independent review of past cases linked to any jailed officer in England and Wales. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 报告建议实施“特鲁法”，自动复核涉及腐败警察的定罪案件
global.summaryZh: 专家指出，未能及时复核涉及腐败警察的案件可能导致更多人蒙冤。拟议的“特鲁法”旨在对英格兰和威尔士所有与入狱警察相关的过往案件进行即时、独立的复核，以纠正司法不公。
global.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过制度化手段纠正因警察腐败导致的冤假错案，维护司法公正。

global.title: Rhode Island’s Democratic governor loses primary amid anger over bridge
global.summary: Helena Foulkes beats incumbent Dan McKee after criticizing handling of Providence’s Washington bridge, now expected to be completed in 2028 Rhode Island’s Dan McKee became the first sitting governor to lose a primary in nearly a decade, bested not by a more progressive challenger or a more youthful upset but by frustration over a bridge. McKee lost his Democratic primary to Helena Foulkes, a former longtime executive with Rhode Island-based retail pharmacy CVS, the Associated Press said on Wednesday. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 罗德岛州民主党州长因大桥处理不当在初选中落败
global.summaryZh: 罗德岛州州长丹·麦基在民主党初选中败给海伦娜·福尔克斯，成为近十年来首位在初选中失利的在任州长。选民对普罗维登斯华盛顿大桥处理方式的不满是导致其落败的主要原因。
global.whyImportant: 地方基础设施管理不善直接影响选民意愿，导致在任官员在初选中遭遇罕见失败。

china.title: Toddler with heart and brain conditions dies after being found unresponsive in bed
china.summary: A 23-month-old girl with heart and brain conditions has died after her parents found her unresponsive at their Hong Kong flat, the South China Morning Post has learned. Police said they received a report from the infant’s mother at 5.30am, saying her daughter had passed out at their light public housing flat at 20 Olympic Avenue in Kai Tak. They added that paramedics arrived shortly afterwards and found the girl unconscious, not breathing and without a pulse. She was taken to Kwong Wah Hospital...
china.titleZh: 一名患有心脏和脑部疾病的幼儿被发现昏迷在床后死亡
china.summaryZh: 香港一名23个月大的女童被父母发现昏迷在床，送医后不治身亡。警方接到报案后，医护人员赶到现场时女童已无呼吸脉搏。
china.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对患病儿童护理及家庭安全保障的关注。

china.title: China wife exposes husband’s US$1.5 million insurance-buying affair involving 180 hotel stays
china.summary: A Chinese man’s seven-year affair with an insurance agent has ignited a legal dispute, revealing dramatic details uncovered by his wife. Guo, from Liuzhou in Guangxi province, southern China, is married to Zhen, with whom he shares a two-year-old daughter, according to Hongxing News. In 2017, Zhen discovered flirtatious messages exchanged between her husband and Li, an insurance agent eight years his junior. These texts included “I miss you” and multiple transfers of 520 yuan (US$77), a figure...
china.titleZh: 中国妻子揭露丈夫与保险代理人的婚外情，涉及150万美元保险购买及180次酒店住宿
china.summaryZh: 广西一名男子被妻子发现与一名保险代理人保持七年婚外情，期间涉及大量资金往来及频繁的酒店开房记录。目前双方已因此引发法律纠纷。
china.whyImportant: 此案因涉及巨额保险购买和长期的婚外关系，在社交媒体和法律层面引发了广泛讨论。

china.title: Softer focus on national security in Hong Kong’s 5-year plan? Why it won’t happen
china.summary: In the first of our series of previews on the five-year plan and policy address, to be announced on September 16, Natalie Wong and Matthew Cheng look at the key political issues and the city leader’s hopes for a second term. When Hong Kong’s leader John Lee Ka-chiu steps up to the Legislative Council podium next Wednesday, he will break from decades of political tradition. Lee’s coming policy address will summarise his four years in office while setting out what is expected to be his most...
china.titleZh: 香港五年规划将淡化国家安全议题？这不太可能发生
china.summaryZh: 香港特首李家超即将发表任内最后一份施政报告，外界关注其对未来五年规划的重点。分析认为，尽管面临不同挑战，国家安全仍将是政策的核心议题，不会被淡化。
china.whyImportant: 该分析明确了香港政府在未来政策制定中对国家安全议题的持续重视程度。

china.title: Susquehanna latest to pick up larger office space in Hong Kong’s Central, sources say
china.summary: US investment firm Susquehanna International Group has agreed to lease more than 4,808 square metres (51,762 square feet) of office space at the Cheung Kong Center II, a prime office skyscraper developed by CK Asset Holdings in Hong Kong’s main business zone of Central, according to market sources. Neither Susquehanna nor CK Asset immediately replied to the South China Morning Post’s requests for comments. The new space would span three floors of the property, according to the...
china.titleZh: 消息称海纳国际集团成为最新租用香港中环大型办公空间的机构
china.summaryZh: 据市场消息，美国投资公司海纳国际集团已租用香港中环长江集团中心二期约4808平方米的办公空间。该租约涵盖了该物业的三层楼面。
china.whyImportant: 大型跨国金融机构在中环核心地段的扩张，反映了市场对香港作为金融中心地位的持续信心。

china.title: US drone ban proposal to combat China’s dominance concerns American police, farmers
china.summary: Greg Reverdiau, an Arizona-based drone trainer, said he saw something highly unusual for politically polarised America when he waded through public comments on a US government proposal to restrict foreign-made drones: a consensus. Reverdiau, the founder of Pilot Institute, which helps aviators obtain licences, said he reviewed over 3,800 comments submitted to the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) and estimates that about 98 per cent opposed the proposal or raised concerns about it. “Those...
china.titleZh: 美国拟禁外国无人机以遏制中国主导地位，引发美警察和农民担忧
china.summaryZh: 美国政府提议限制外国制造的无人机，但遭到大量公众评论反对。许多美国警察和农民担心此举将增加运营成本并影响工作效率。
china.whyImportant: 该提案在政治极化的美国引发了罕见的跨行业共识，凸显了地缘政治政策对国内民生行业的实际影响。

usa.title: Trump claims he will give $5,000 to every American if Republicans win the midterms as he defends Iran war and tariffs– as it happened
usa.summary: This live blog is now closed. Stefany Shaheen’s mother Jeanne Shaheen is a former governor who has represented New Hampshire in the Senate since 2009. The younger Shaheen’s family ties to the Democratic establishment – and accusations of nepotism – became a point of attack by her opponent in the primary race. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 特朗普声称若共和党赢得中期选举将向每位美国人发放5000美元，并为伊朗战争和关税辩护
usa.summaryZh: 特朗普在会议演讲中承诺，若共和党在中期选举中获胜，将向每位美国公民发放5000美元。同时，他还在演讲中为关税政策及伊朗相关立场进行了辩护。
usa.whyImportant: 特朗普的竞选承诺和政策立场直接影响中期选举的选情走向及选民预期。

usa.title: Rubio says US will work with allies to stop drug-trafficking as three killed in latest boat strike
usa.summary: Rubio visits Ecuador and welcomes cooperation after campaign of unilateral strikes on alleged ‘narco-terrorists’ US secretary of state Marco Rubio gave new clarity on the approach toward combating drug trafficking in Latin American waters, saying the Trump administration was focused on working with allied countries and aligning with their laws but insisting the military will “still blow up ships if need be.” The public acknowledgment of a shift in US strategy comes a year after Washington began a campaign of unilateral deadly strikes against those it calls “narco-terrorists” operating boats in international waters. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 卢比奥称美国将与盟友合作打击毒品走私，最新船只袭击事件造成三人死亡
usa.summaryZh: 美国国务卿卢比奥在访问厄瓜多尔时表示，特朗普政府将致力于与盟国合作打击拉美海域的毒品走私。尽管强调会遵循盟国法律，但他同时重申美军在必要时仍会采取摧毁船只的军事行动。
usa.whyImportant: 此举标志着美国在打击拉美地区“毒品恐怖主义”的策略上，从单边行动转向更强调与盟友的协调与合作。

usa.title: First Lady Melania Trump’s Personal Vision to Preserve America’s Story Through Superior Design
usa.summary: First Lady Melania Trump shared her forward-looking vision on the generational significance of institutional design, declaring that, “The White House stands as an architectural autobiography of America, embodying the enduring values of ambition, democracy, and civic life through its design, craftmanship, and the objects within.” First Lady Melania Trump’s elevated creative vision has played a […] The post First Lady Melania Trump’s Personal Vision to Preserve America’s Story Through Superior Design appeared first on The White House.
usa.titleZh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普通过卓越设计保护美国故事的个人愿景
usa.summaryZh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普分享了她对机构设计代际意义的愿景，称白宫是美国建筑的自传。她认为白宫的设计、工艺及其内部陈设体现了雄心、民主和公民生活的持久价值。
usa.whyImportant: 该声明强调了第一夫人对白宫作为国家象征及其文化遗产保护工作的重视。

usa.title: Iran likely to reverse-engineer captured US underwater drone
usa.summary: Iran’s capture of a US military underwater drone gives Tehran an opportunity to study and potentially reverse-engineer the vessel, delivering a setback for the Pentagon and drone maker Anduril. The US military and Anduril have downplayed the significance of the drone falling into Iranian hands. The vessel, a Dive-LD autonomous underwater vehicle designed for long-range surveillance and other undersea missions, is among a new ‌generation of military drones intended to operate for days with little...
usa.titleZh: 伊朗可能对捕获的美国水下无人机进行逆向工程
usa.summaryZh: 伊朗捕获了一架美国军用Dive-LD自主水下航行器，这为德黑兰研究并可能进行逆向工程提供了机会。尽管美方和制造商淡化了此次事件的影响，但该设备代表了美军新一代长航时监视技术。
usa.whyImportant: 美军先进无人潜航器技术的泄露可能对美国的海底监视能力和军事技术优势构成潜在威胁。

usa.title: Tung Chee-hwa hailed as visionary leader who helped build US-China relations
usa.summary: Hong Kong’s first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, who died on Tuesday, has been lauded as “one of the greatest movers in China-US relations”, with a foundation established by Neil Bush, a former American president’s son, praising Tung’s “profound contributions” to deepening ties between the two nations. The US consulate and former city leader Donald Tsang Yam-kuen also praised Tung’s work in strengthening ties between the United States and Hong Kong, paving the way for deeper business links and...
usa.titleZh: 董建华被誉为推动美中关系发展的远见卓识领导人
usa.summaryZh: 香港首任行政长官董建华逝世后，多方对其表示哀悼，称其为美中关系的重要推动者。尼尔·布什及美国领事馆等均肯定了他在深化美中及美港经贸联系方面所作的贡献。
usa.whyImportant: 各界对董建华的评价凸显了他在促进中美双边关系及香港国际地位方面所发挥的历史性作用。

watch.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
watch.summary: Tehran condemns the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.
watch.titleZh: 伊朗因核不合规问题被移交至联合国安理会
watch.summaryZh: 伊朗因核不合规问题被正式移交至联合国安理会处理。德黑兰方面对此决议表示谴责，并将核查受阻归咎于美国和以色列对其核设施的打击。
watch.whyImportant: 此举加剧了伊朗与国际社会在核问题上的紧张关系，可能引发新一轮的外交博弈或制裁。

watch.title: Japan’s China-facing military build-up confronts labour, budget and political limits
watch.summary: The risk of a conflict over Taiwan is shaping Japanese defence planning, with Tokyo shoring up security at home and abroad for a potentially prolonged fight. But there are economic, demographic and political constraints on how far its military transformation can go. In the third of a three-part series, Gabriel Dominguez examines the various challenges confronting Japan in its bid to expand its military. Driven by the growing risk that a conflict over Taiwan could draw Tokyo into a high-intensity...
watch.titleZh: 日本面向中国的军事建设面临劳动力、预算和政治限制
watch.summaryZh: 受台海冲突风险影响，日本正致力于加强本土及海外防御能力。然而，日本在扩大军事规模的过程中，正面临严峻的经济、人口结构及国内政治约束。
watch.whyImportant: 日本在提升军事威慑力方面的努力受到多重现实因素的制约，反映了其在地区安全战略上的复杂处境。

watch.title: August was hottest month ever recorded globally, scientists say
watch.summary: The EU’s climate monitor said on Thursday that August was the hottest single month ever recorded globally, with ocean temperatures also reaching unprecedented highs as western Europe capped its warmest summer. In response to the assessment by the Copernicus Climate Change Service, the UN warned that until humanity weaned off fossil fuels, the planet would only push deeper into uncharted territory. Copernicus observations go back to 1940 but other evidence – such as ice cores, tree rings and...
watch.titleZh: 科学家称八月是有记录以来全球最热月份
watch.summaryZh: 欧盟气候监测机构指出，八月成为全球有记录以来最热的月份，海洋温度也达到前所未有的高度。联合国警告称，若人类不摆脱对化石燃料的依赖，地球气候将进入更危险的未知领域。
watch.whyImportant: 持续打破纪录的高温数据再次为全球气候变化危机敲响了警钟，凸显了能源转型的紧迫性。

items.title: Israel sanctions will not hurt intelligence sharing between spy agencies, says Miliband
items.summary: UK foreign secretary says international community including US shares ‘frustration’ at Israel’s failure to constrain illegal settlers British intelligence has been given assurances by its Israeli counterpart that information sharing with the UK will continue as before, Ed Miliband, the foreign secretary, has said. The disclosure counters predictions that his decision to impose a ban on trade with illegal Israeli settlements would lead to a collapse in cooperation between the agencies. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 米利班德称，以色列制裁不会损害情报机构间的情报共享
items.summaryZh: 英国外交大臣米利班德表示，尽管英国对以色列非法定居点实施了贸易禁令，但已获得以色列方面的保证，双方的情报合作将保持不变。此举旨在平息关于合作可能破裂的猜测。
items.whyImportant: 这表明英国在对以政策上试图在外交制裁与国家安全合作之间寻求平衡。

items.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
items.summary: The fire broke out as the vessel nearing its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan.
items.titleZh: 菲律宾一渡轮发生“令人心碎”的火灾，造成5人死亡，86人失踪
items.summaryZh: 这艘渡轮在接近旅游胜地巴拉望岛科隆时突然起火。目前搜救工作正在进行中。
items.whyImportant: 此次海上事故造成了严重的人员伤亡，引发了对当地渡轮安全标准的关注。

items.title: Netanyahu to sue Haaretz over claims UAE warned him before October 7 attack
items.summary: Israeli prime minister denies claim that UAE president warned him of Hamas plans before the 2023 attacks.
items.titleZh: 内塔尼亚胡将起诉《国土报》，因其报道称阿联酋在10月7日袭击前曾发出警告
items.summaryZh: 以色列总理否认了关于阿联酋总统在2023年袭击发生前曾向其通报哈马斯计划的说法。他计划就此报道采取法律行动。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了以色列政府对战前情报预警相关报道的高度敏感及政治压力。

items.titleZh: 澳大利亚政治直播：公共部门工会宣布新领导人；民调显示工党在处理家庭暴力问题上行动迟缓
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚工党正计划引入新法律以打击非法烟草贸易，通过更严格的包装和价格标准赋予边境执法部门更多权力。同时，政府在应对家庭暴力问题上的表现受到民调批评。
items.whyImportant: 政府在打击非法贸易和应对社会民生问题上的政策调整，直接影响其执政支持率。

items.title: SMH columnist Peter FitzSimons tells Alan Jones trial alleged victim was ‘revolted’ by abuse
items.summary: FitzSimons tells court that complainant C told him Jones, who has pleaded not guilty, would touch his penis and he ‘kept pushing it away’ Listen to the podcast Alan Jones on Trial Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Sydney Morning Herald columnist Peter FitzSimons has told the Alan Jones trial an alleged victim he spoke to in 2019 was “tearful” and sounded “emotionally traumatised” when detailing alleged assaults by the 2GB broadcaster. items.titleZh: 《悉尼先驱晨报》专栏作家彼得·菲茨西蒙斯在艾伦·琼斯案审判中称受害者感到“反感”
items.summaryZh: 菲茨西蒙斯在法庭上作证称，他在2019年与一名受害者通话时，对方详细描述了广播员艾伦·琼斯对其进行的性骚扰。琼斯目前对指控表示不认罪。
items.whyImportant: 该案件涉及知名媒体人的性侵指控，在澳大利亚社会引起了广泛关注。

items.title: US citizens will receive $5,000 if Republicans win midterms, Trump claims in lengthy convention speech
items.summary: In two-hour address, president asked voters to ‘pretend that I’m on the ballot’ despite being deeply unpopular among electorate Donald Trump said every adult citizen in the US will receive a dividend of $5,000 if Republicans retain the House and Senate in the midterm elections, while delivering a historically long convention speech in Dallas in which the president assailed Democrats as radical communists and defended his unpopular war in Iran. “If the Republicans win, you win with us, and you get $5,000,” Trump told the Republican midterm convention in Dallas on Wednesday, claiming the payment was possible “because of our tremendous strength and success economically”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普在竞选集会上声称，若共和党赢得中期选举，美国公民将获得5000美元
items.summaryZh: 特朗普在达拉斯的集会上承诺，如果共和党能保住参众两院的控制权，每位成年公民将获得5000美元的红利。他同时抨击了民主党并为伊朗战争辩护。
items.whyImportant: 这一激进的经济承诺是特朗普试图在中期选举中动员选民的重要策略。

items.title: Lawmakers blast AI companies after researcher warns of human extinction by 2030
items.summary: Former Anthropic employee Jacob Coxon said AI will become ‘superhuman systems’ that can cause human extinction by the end of the decade Just a day after three Anthropic researchers warned that artificial intelligence could kill off humanity within the decade, lawmakers have begun lashing out about the risks of the burgeoning technology. Ted Cruz, a republican senator from Texas, said in an interview on ABC’s The View, that AI poses a “catastrophic risk” and that he “read that whole tweet thread that that developer put out. It was highly concerning. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 研究人员警告人工智能可能导致人类灭绝，立法者猛烈抨击AI公司
items.summaryZh: 前Anthropic员工雅各布·考克森警告称，人工智能可能在十年内演变为导致人类灭绝的“超人系统”。对此，美国参议员泰德·克鲁兹等立法者表达了严重关切。
items.whyImportant: 人工智能的潜在生存风险正促使政界加强对科技行业的监管审查。

items.title: US scrambles to match China’s air-breathing hypersonic missiles with Darpa programme
items.summary: A year after China unveiled the world’s first operational air-breathing hypersonic missiles, the United States is launching a programme to double down on developing similar weapons. The US Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency (Darpa) will bring contractors together later this month to lay out what it wants from the Next Generation Hypersonic Cruise Missile, with air-breathing propulsion at the heart of the project, according to the agency’s website. Unlike rocket-powered missiles,...
items.titleZh: 美国加紧研发“吸气式”高超音速导弹以追赶中国
items.summaryZh: 在美国国防高级研究计划局（DARPA）的推动下，美国正启动新一代高超音速巡航导弹项目。此举旨在应对中国在吸气式高超音速武器领域取得的领先地位。
items.whyImportant: 大国之间在高超音速武器技术上的竞争加剧，对全球军事平衡产生深远影响。

items.title: Enact Trew’s law to automatically review ‘bent copper’ convictions, says report
items.summary: Experts say failure to immediately review cases involving corrupt police officers risks ‘ruining’ more lives Convictions that imprisoned police officers were involved in obtaining should be automatically reviewed to correct miscarriages of justice such as those perpetrated by the corrupt and racist officer DS Derek Ridgewell, a report says. The proposed Trew’s law, named after Winston Trew – who was framed by Ridgewell and spent decades fighting to clear his name – would trigger an immediate, independent review of past cases linked to any jailed officer in England and Wales. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 报告建议实施“特鲁法”，自动复核涉及腐败警察的定罪案件
items.summaryZh: 专家指出，未能及时复核涉及腐败警察的案件可能导致更多人蒙冤。拟议的“特鲁法”旨在对英格兰和威尔士所有与入狱警察相关的过往案件进行即时、独立的复核，以纠正司法不公。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过制度化手段纠正因警察腐败导致的冤假错案，维护司法公正。

items.title: Rhode Island’s Democratic governor loses primary amid anger over bridge
items.summary: Helena Foulkes beats incumbent Dan McKee after criticizing handling of Providence’s Washington bridge, now expected to be completed in 2028 Rhode Island’s Dan McKee became the first sitting governor to lose a primary in nearly a decade, bested not by a more progressive challenger or a more youthful upset but by frustration over a bridge. McKee lost his Democratic primary to Helena Foulkes, a former longtime executive with Rhode Island-based retail pharmacy CVS, the Associated Press said on Wednesday. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 罗德岛州民主党州长因大桥处理不当在初选中落败
items.summaryZh: 罗德岛州州长丹·麦基在民主党初选中败给海伦娜·福尔克斯，成为近十年来首位在初选中失利的在任州长。选民对普罗维登斯华盛顿大桥处理方式的不满是导致其落败的主要原因。
items.whyImportant: 地方基础设施管理不善直接影响选民意愿，导致在任官员在初选中遭遇罕见失败。

items.title: Toddler with heart and brain conditions dies after being found unresponsive in bed
items.summary: A 23-month-old girl with heart and brain conditions has died after her parents found her unresponsive at their Hong Kong flat, the South China Morning Post has learned. Police said they received a report from the infant’s mother at 5.30am, saying her daughter had passed out at their light public housing flat at 20 Olympic Avenue in Kai Tak. They added that paramedics arrived shortly afterwards and found the girl unconscious, not breathing and without a pulse. She was taken to Kwong Wah Hospital...
items.titleZh: 一名患有心脏和脑部疾病的幼儿被发现昏迷在床后死亡
items.summaryZh: 香港一名23个月大的女童被父母发现昏迷在床，送医后不治身亡。警方接到报案后，医护人员赶到现场时女童已无呼吸脉搏。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对患病儿童护理及家庭安全保障的关注。

items.title: China wife exposes husband’s US$1.5 million insurance-buying affair involving 180 hotel stays
items.summary: A Chinese man’s seven-year affair with an insurance agent has ignited a legal dispute, revealing dramatic details uncovered by his wife. Guo, from Liuzhou in Guangxi province, southern China, is married to Zhen, with whom he shares a two-year-old daughter, according to Hongxing News. items.titleZh: 中国妻子揭露丈夫与保险代理人的婚外情，涉及150万美元保险购买及180次酒店住宿
items.summaryZh: 广西一名男子被妻子发现与一名保险代理人保持七年婚外情，期间涉及大量资金往来及频繁的酒店开房记录。目前双方已因此引发法律纠纷。
items.whyImportant: 此案因涉及巨额保险购买和长期的婚外关系，在社交媒体和法律层面引发了广泛讨论。

items.title: Softer focus on national security in Hong Kong’s 5-year plan? Why it won’t happen
items.summary: In the first of our series of previews on the five-year plan and policy address, to be announced on September 16, Natalie Wong and Matthew Cheng look at the key political issues and the city leader’s hopes for a second term. When Hong Kong’s leader John Lee Ka-chiu steps up to the Legislative Council podium next Wednesday, he will break from decades of political tradition. items.titleZh: 香港五年规划将淡化国家安全议题？这不太可能发生
items.summaryZh: 香港特首李家超即将发表任内最后一份施政报告，外界关注其对未来五年规划的重点。分析认为，尽管面临不同挑战，国家安全仍将是政策的核心议题，不会被淡化。
items.whyImportant: 该分析明确了香港政府在未来政策制定中对国家安全议题的持续重视程度。

items.title: Susquehanna latest to pick up larger office space in Hong Kong’s Central, sources say

Neither Susquehanna nor CK Asset immediately replied to the South China Morning Post’s requests for comments. The new space would span three floors of the property, according to the...
items.titleZh: 消息称海纳国际集团成为最新租用香港中环大型办公空间的机构
items.summaryZh: 据市场消息，美国投资公司海纳国际集团已租用香港中环长江集团中心二期约4808平方米的办公空间。该租约涵盖了该物业的三层楼面。

items.title: US drone ban proposal to combat China’s dominance concerns American police, farmers
items.summary: Greg Reverdiau, an Arizona-based drone trainer, said he saw something highly unusual for politically polarised America when he waded through public comments on a US government proposal to restrict foreign-made drones: a consensus. items.titleZh: 美国拟禁外国无人机以遏制中国主导地位，引发美警察和农民担忧
items.summaryZh: 美国政府提议限制外国制造的无人机，但遭到大量公众评论反对。许多美国警察和农民担心此举将增加运营成本并影响工作效率。
items.whyImportant: 该提案在政治极化的美国引发了罕见的跨行业共识，凸显了地缘政治政策对国内民生行业的实际影响。

items.title: Trump claims he will give $5,000 to every American if Republicans win the midterms as he defends Iran war and tariffs– as it happened

items.titleZh: 特朗普声称若共和党赢得中期选举将向每位美国人发放5000美元，并为伊朗战争和关税辩护

items.title: Rubio says US will work with allies to stop drug-trafficking as three killed in latest boat strike
items.summary: Rubio visits Ecuador and welcomes cooperation after campaign of unilateral strikes on alleged ‘narco-terrorists’ US secretary of state Marco Rubio gave new clarity on the approach toward combating drug trafficking in Latin American waters, saying the Trump administration was focused on working with allied countries and aligning with their laws but insisting the military will “still blow up ships if need be.” The public acknowledgment of a shift in US strategy comes a year after Washington began a campaign of unilateral deadly strikes against those it calls “narco-terrorists” operating boats in international waters. items.titleZh: 卢比奥称美国将与盟友合作打击毒品走私，最新船只袭击事件造成三人死亡
items.summaryZh: 美国国务卿卢比奥在访问厄瓜多尔时表示，特朗普政府将致力于与盟国合作打击拉美海域的毒品走私。尽管强调会遵循盟国法律，但他同时重申美军在必要时仍会采取摧毁船只的军事行动。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着美国在打击拉美地区“毒品恐怖主义”的策略上，从单边行动转向更强调与盟友的协调与合作。

items.title: First Lady Melania Trump’s Personal Vision to Preserve America’s Story Through Superior Design
items.summary: First Lady Melania Trump shared her forward-looking vision on the generational significance of institutional design, declaring that, “The White House stands as an architectural autobiography of America, embodying the enduring values of ambition, democracy, and civic life through its design, craftmanship, and the objects within.” First Lady Melania Trump’s elevated creative vision has played a […] The post First Lady Melania Trump’s Personal Vision to Preserve America’s Story Through Superior Design appeared first on The White House.
items.titleZh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普通过卓越设计保护美国故事的个人愿景
items.summaryZh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普分享了她对机构设计代际意义的愿景，称白宫是美国建筑的自传。她认为白宫的设计、工艺及其内部陈设体现了雄心、民主和公民生活的持久价值。
items.whyImportant: 该声明强调了第一夫人对白宫作为国家象征及其文化遗产保护工作的重视。

items.title: Iran likely to reverse-engineer captured US underwater drone
items.summary: Iran’s capture of a US military underwater drone gives Tehran an opportunity to study and potentially reverse-engineer the vessel, delivering a setback for the Pentagon and drone maker Anduril. The US military and Anduril have downplayed the significance of the drone falling into Iranian hands. The vessel, a Dive-LD autonomous underwater vehicle designed for long-range surveillance and other undersea missions, is among a new ‌generation of military drones intended to operate for days with little...
items.titleZh: 伊朗可能对捕获的美国水下无人机进行逆向工程
items.summaryZh: 伊朗捕获了一架美国军用Dive-LD自主水下航行器，这为德黑兰研究并可能进行逆向工程提供了机会。尽管美方和制造商淡化了此次事件的影响，但该设备代表了美军新一代长航时监视技术。
items.whyImportant: 美军先进无人潜航器技术的泄露可能对美国的海底监视能力和军事技术优势构成潜在威胁。

items.title: Tung Chee-hwa hailed as visionary leader who helped build US-China relations
items.summary: Hong Kong’s first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, who died on Tuesday, has been lauded as “one of the greatest movers in China-US relations”, with a foundation established by Neil Bush, a former American president’s son, praising Tung’s “profound contributions” to deepening ties between the two nations. The US consulate and former city leader Donald Tsang Yam-kuen also praised Tung’s work in strengthening ties between the United States and Hong Kong, paving the way for deeper business links and...
items.titleZh: 董建华被誉为推动美中关系发展的远见卓识领导人
items.summaryZh: 香港首任行政长官董建华逝世后，多方对其表示哀悼，称其为美中关系的重要推动者。尼尔·布什及美国领事馆等均肯定了他在深化美中及美港经贸联系方面所作的贡献。
items.whyImportant: 各界对董建华的评价凸显了他在促进中美双边关系及香港国际地位方面所发挥的历史性作用。

items.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
items.summary: Tehran condemns the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.
items.titleZh: 伊朗因核不合规问题被移交至联合国安理会
items.summaryZh: 伊朗因核不合规问题被正式移交至联合国安理会处理。德黑兰方面对此决议表示谴责，并将核查受阻归咎于美国和以色列对其核设施的打击。
items.whyImportant: 此举加剧了伊朗与国际社会在核问题上的紧张关系，可能引发新一轮的外交博弈或制裁。

items.title: Japan’s China-facing military build-up confronts labour, budget and political limits
items.summary: The risk of a conflict over Taiwan is shaping Japanese defence planning, with Tokyo shoring up security at home and abroad for a potentially prolonged fight. But there are economic, demographic and political constraints on how far its military transformation can go. In the third of a three-part series, Gabriel Dominguez examines the various challenges confronting Japan in its bid to expand its military. items.titleZh: 日本面向中国的军事建设面临劳动力、预算和政治限制
items.summaryZh: 受台海冲突风险影响，日本正致力于加强本土及海外防御能力。然而，日本在扩大军事规模的过程中，正面临严峻的经济、人口结构及国内政治约束。
items.whyImportant: 日本在提升军事威慑力方面的努力受到多重现实因素的制约，反映了其在地区安全战略上的复杂处境。

items.title: August was hottest month ever recorded globally, scientists say
items.summary: The EU’s climate monitor said on Thursday that August was the hottest single month ever recorded globally, with ocean temperatures also reaching unprecedented highs as western Europe capped its warmest summer. In response to the assessment by the Copernicus Climate Change Service, the UN warned that until humanity weaned off fossil fuels, the planet would only push deeper into uncharted territory. items.titleZh: 科学家称八月是有记录以来全球最热月份
items.summaryZh: 欧盟气候监测机构指出，八月成为全球有记录以来最热的月份，海洋温度也达到前所未有的高度。联合国警告称，若人类不摆脱对化石燃料的依赖，地球气候将进入更危险的未知领域。
items.whyImportant: 持续打破纪录的高温数据再次为全球气候变化危机敲响了警钟，凸显了能源转型的紧迫性。
